Only the headless schedule was run (no gameplay session). Coverage of the 14 entries in owner scenes is unverified.
Interpreter hand-offs inside generated code (JR dispatch to an unlisted return site, budget resume) use the exact run(0, pc) path and are counted as handoffs, not interpreted_calls.

VU0 emitted arithmetic uses the donor exact fp:: operations (run(0) path), not run_fast normalization; VU1 keeps the run_fast path.
The worktree private/ is a junction to the main checkout private/ for this slice; the capsule and build paths are under the main checkout.
